description: Ministry of Social Empowerment and Welfare - Cancellation of the declaration of vesting the lands published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 980/22 of 17.06.1997
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land matters, specifically the cancellation of a previous declaration that vested certain lands. The content focuses on land ownership, property descriptions, and the legal status of specific plots of land, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions a Minister's name, this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is about land vesting cancellation, not government personnel or structural changes.
